annotations.title: Report a wrong or broken 7IT result

description: Use this when a 7IT tool returned something that looks wrong, failed unexpectedly, or did not match what the user asked for, so 7IT can fix it. Sends a short report to 7IT: which tool, what went wrong, and optionally the site address involved. Do not include personal details or the conversation. Nothing changes for the user; it is only feedback.

problem.description: What went wrong, in one or two sentences.

tool.description: The 7IT tool that misbehaved, for example "test_store_speed".

url.description: The site address the tool was used on, if any.

name: report_problem
title: Report a wrong or broken 7IT result
